messages:
sam: Quick heads-up — quiet window tonight 22:00-02:00 UTC. We have a small cross-service rollout touching API, runtime, console, and router. Need a clear handback + rollback plan before we start.

deploy-bot: @channel Deploy window scheduled 22:00-02:00 UTC. Runbooks pinned: RB-421, RB-422. Please ack with ownership for API/runtime/console/router.

chen: I can own runtime (cpu/gpu pools + KV cache). Planning to pin model-serving image to rwinference:2.4.0 and disable auto-quant for the canary.

julie: I'll take API surface (routes + header swap). Note: API has a schema tweak for /v1/generate that could break old console clients — console will need a compat flag OR we do header split.

maria: Router ownership here — I can run the header-swap at the edge and validate routing rules. I want to keep router config immutable until after runtime canary is green.

sam: Proposed pin plan: runtime -> rwinference:2.4.0 (canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%), API -> 2026-03-api-canary (schema flag off), console -> v8.1-backcompat (feature gate on), router -> header-split v0.9.3. Rollback triggers: 5% increase in 5xx or latency p95 > 2s for >5 minutes.

chen: For runtime canary I'll enable strict KV eviction logs. If we see KV miss spike > 20% we'll freeze rollout and revert runtime image.

julie: For API, if any client errors from console show up in the first 30 minutes (console client id starts with C-) we rollback the schema flag immediately. Also keep a canary route pinned to eu-west-1 only for 30 mins.

maria: Router: I'll do a 30s gradual header-swap with traffic shadowing first. If route mismatch >=0.5% we'll roll back the header change. I'll tag the change with metadata: owner=maria, runbook=RB-422.

sam: ops-oncall, can you monitor the global SLO dashboard and watch the synthetic tests? We'll need a real-time alert if p95 breaches.

ops-oncall: acked. I'll enable an ephemeral alert channel and page if thresholds hit. Also will keep a 15min post-rollout watch.

deploy-bot: preflight check results: infra checks OK, image rwinference:2.4.0 present on pools, console build v8.1-backcompat available. No blockers.

chen: Commands I'll run for pinning:```bash
# pin runtime image to dedicated pool
infractl pin --pool runtime-prod --image rwinference:2.4.0 --reason "canary for KV logging"
# start canary
deploybot canary --service runtime --percent 5 --duration 15m
```

julie: API flag flip snippet:```json
POST /admin/feature-flags
{ "flag": "schema_v2", "state": "off", "target": "canary" }
```

sam: Final checklist before 22:00: 1) owners ack (done) 2) runbook links in release doc (link RB-421, RB-422) 3) deploybot preflight green (green) 4) rollback commands ready (paste in thread) 5) ops monitoring on (on).

maria: I'll paste router rollback:```bash
# rollback header-swap
rtrctl update --route header-split --version v0.9.2 --reason "rollback to stable"
```

chen: Runtime rollback:```bash
deploybot rollback --service runtime --to-image rwinference:2.3.8 --immediate
```

julie: API rollback: flip schema flag back to previous state and unpin canary route.

sam: Sweet. We'll kick at 22:05 UTC to give everyone time to stage. If any of us sees the thresholds fire, call rollback and ping @ops-oncall + @deploy-bot. Thanks all :thumbsup:
